title: Income Tax: changes to tax rates for property and savings income
text:
These measures will increase the: 

 • 
 property basic rate to 24%, property higher rate to 44% and the property additional rate to 49% from 6 April 2027 

 • 
 savings basic rate to 24%, savings higher rate to 44% and the savings additional rate to 49% from 6 April 2027
